experiment: P6 K/history unknown-EOS self-history calibration simulation v1
model: same ridge alpha=100 trained once on all fit K/history rows with fit-only normalization

threshold.source: median of frozen fit source-OOF K predictions

controller.coverage: execute offset0 of every four-window block, including incomplete tail block
controller.bonus_candidate: offset2 of each complete block only
controller.learned_action: when eligible and not forced, execute iff predicted log-JS >= fixed threshold
controller.state: only posteriors of windows actually executed by this policy plus current offset0; skipped blocks add no previous-offset entry

comparators.online_uniform: same token initial/accrual; eagerly execute whenever eligible; no EOS/topup
comparators.matched_count_uniform: offline diagnostic placing exactly the policy's observed bonus count evenly within each sample
comparators.known_length_teacher_forced_K: previous confirmation result only, not recomputed or used for decisions
comparators.full_center: execute offset0 and offset2 in every complete block

decision: all gates pass to retain K/history as a deployable-controller candidate and permit separately frozen final held-out planning; any failure stops before held-out
